leo_ops: Heads-up: spikes in p99 encode latency on eu2 edge, starting ~04:22UTC. GPUs idle, NIC tx queue4 saturated, packet drops.
anya_sched: top talkers?
leo_ops: flow-agg: tenant-streaming (46%), tenant-audit (19%), infra-repl (15%), misc. Lots of tiny RPCs holding the TX rings.
mira_net: also seeing a driver patch landed last week that changed coalescing defaults on hosts in eu2. Could be exacerbating irq storms.
pete_sre: quick mitigation: create a cross-AZ quiet slice replicated in eu2 (quiet-eu2-crossaz), enable per-host eBPF tx shaping, soft-redirect noisy tenants. Keep slice preemptible to limit reserved cost.
anya_sched: plan: 1) tag tenants; 2) soft-weight route 15% -> monitor 12m -> 45% -> full if stable; 3) capture telemetry and billing delta. Rollback if p99 not improved by 30% or if preemptions spike.
leo_ops: commands to enact (safe-mode):
```bash
kubectl annotate tenant tenant-streaming routing=quiet-eu2-crossaz
kubectl annotate tenant tenant-audit routing=quiet-eu2-crossaz
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  https://scheduler.internal/api/v1/routes/weights \
  -d '{"slice":"quiet-eu2-crossaz","weight":0.15,"region":"eu2"}'
```
pete_sre: deploybot, create incident and page if p99>220ms for 10m.
deploybot: Incident INC-2026-6330 created "eu2 crossAZ egress tail" paging thresholds set.
mira_net: enabled eBPF probe to capture per-pod tx bursts and ring occupancy; also toggled a conservative coalescing override on hosts as a temporary knob.
costbot: Note: if we convert slice to reserved for 24h estimated delta ~$1.9k; preemptible keeps increase minimal. Tracking under INC-2026-6330.
anya_sched: start 15% now at 04:35UTC. Observation window 12m. If we see improvement, ramp to 45% then 100% with 12m windows. If oscillation appears, shard slice across additional AZs and consider reverting driver coalescing to previous defaults.
leo_ops: 04:48UTC update: p99 improved from 510ms -> 310ms with 15% routing; per-host tx ring depth down ~38%. Positive signal.
pete_sre: proceed to 45% now, remember to record billing delta and file a postmortem linking the driver change. Long term: scheduler-level soft-quotas + proxy token-bucket pacing to prevent pps spikes.
anya_sched: recording runbook "quiet-eu2-crossaz soft-redirect" and owning follow-ups.
leo_ops: thanks team. will keep slice up for 24h and post RCA timeline.
